AC Up.Description: Your Pokémon’s AC increases by 1. This bonus is included through a Pokémon’s evolutions.

Able-Bodied.Description: Your Pokemon's body is trained to learn from and fight off ailments for long periods of time. After recovering from a status effect, this Pokemon becomes immune to the same status for 3 rounds.

Actor.Description:
Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks made to pass yourself off as someone else.
• After hearing a person speak or a creature make a sound for at least 1 minute, you can imitate it. A listener recognizes the imitation as false by succeeding on a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check.

Alert.Description:
While conscious, you cannot be surprised.
• The Trainer gains a +5 bonus to initiative while this is the active Pokémon. This bonus does not stack with the Trainer’s own Alert feat.
• Creatures you cannot see do not gain advantage on attack rolls against you solely because they are unseen.

Athlete (DEX).Description:
Your Dexterity score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Standing up from being prone uses only 5 feet of your movement.
• Climbing does not cost extra movement.
• You can make a running long jump or high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

Athlete (STR).Description:
Your Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• Standing up from being prone uses only 5 feet of your movement.
• Climbing does not cost extra movement.
• You can make a running long jump or high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

Charger.Description: When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee attack or shove a creature. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before this bonus action, a successful melee attack deals +5 damage, or a successful shove pushes the target up to 10 feet away from you.

Combo Master.Description: Your Pokémon is an expert in combining strikes against a foe. When this feature is selected, combo moves that have the ability to hit more than once are guaranteed to hit at least twice. (Fury Swipes, Double Slap, etc.)

Durable.Description: Your Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points regained from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier, with a minimum of 2.

Elemental Adept.Description: Choose one Pokémon damage type when you gain this feat. Moves you activate ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. When you roll damage for a move of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different damage type each time.

Extra Move.Description: Your Pokémon can know five total moves instead of four.

Hidden Ability.Description: Your Pokémon reaches inside itself to discover a new ability. It gains access to the Hidden Ability in its stat block.

Melee Master.Description: Your Pokemon is a master of close combat. Gain advantage on all attacks of opportunity. Before you make a melee attack, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack’s damage (Once per move).

Mobile.Description:
Your speed increases by 10 feet.
• When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain does not cost extra movement that turn.
• After you make a melee attack against a creature, you do not provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether the attack hits or misses.

Observant.Description:
Your Intelligence or Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
• If you can see a creature’s mouth while it speaks a language you understand, you can interpret its words by reading its lips.
• You gain a +5 bonus to passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation).

Power Sculptor.Description: Your Pokémon is able to sculpt the power of their moves around their allies. For area of effect moves your Pokémon activates, choose 1 + MOVE allies in range to automatically succeed on their saving throw against taking damage or an effect. If the damage is halved for a successful save, they take no damage instead.

Ranged Master.Description: Your Pokemon is a sharpshooter. Your ranged attacks ignore half and three-fourths cover, Before you make a ranged attack, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack’s damage (Once per move).

Resilient (CHA).Description: Your Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you gain proficiency in Charisma saving throws.

Resilient (CON).Description: Your Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws.

Resilient (DEX).Description: Your Dexterity score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you gain proficiency in Dexterity saving throws.

Resilient (INT).Description: Your Intelligence score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you gain proficiency in Intelligence saving throws.

Resilient (STR).Description: Your Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you gain proficiency in Strength saving throws.

Resilient (WIS).Description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20, and you gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

Savage Attacker.Description: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee attack, you can reroll the attack’s damage dice and use either total.

Sentinel.Description:
When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, its speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.
• Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action before leaving your reach.
• When a creature within 5 feet of you attacks a target other than you, and that target does not have this feat, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the attacker.

Skilled.Description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice other than Animal Handling.

Skulker.Description:
Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher.
• You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature you are hiding from.
• When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged attack, the attack does not reveal your position.
• Dim light does not impose disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Terrain Adept.Description: Your Pokémon is especially skilled when fighting on a specific terrain. Choose one of the following terrains when selecting this feature. Your Pokémon gains +2 to attack rolls when in this terrain. Terrains: Coastal, Swamp, Forest, Arctic, Desert, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Underwater.

Tireless.Description: Your Pokémon endures hours of rigorous training which keep it in battle longer than the average Pokémon. Gain +1 PP for every move.

Tough.Description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by 2 additional hit points.

Wrangler.Description:
You have developed a unique set of skills that give you the ability to grapple and hold an opponent down with steady and strong hands. You gain the following benefits:
* You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are Grappling.
* You can use your action to try to pin a creature already Grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both Restrained until the grapple ends.
* When a creature attempts to use their movement to leave your reach without disengaging, you may use your reaction to attempt to Grapple the target.
